outcome: Severity of hypertensive disorders in pregnancy (HDP)
cohort: The study included 54 pregnant women with hypertensive disorders in pregnancy (HDP) and 42 healthy pregnant women, all of whom delivered at Zhoushan Hospital.
finding: Combined testing of activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT), D-Dimer, and prothrombin time (PT) demonstrated high predictive efficacy for both hypertensive disorders in pregnancy (HDP) and adverse birth outcomes (ABO), and was closely associated with HDP severity.
